# Tralala.cards

> Tralala is a free conversation card game that runs in the browser. One phone shows one question at a time; the group reads it out loud, everyone answers, and the phone gets passed on. No account, no sign-up, no download.

## What it offers

- Hundreds of questions in 11 decks: The Appliance Union, Know me (icebreakers), 3AM (late-night questions), Office (team questions), Spicy (18+), Do Not Disturb (questions for introverts), Firsts, Awkward, Double Trouble (couples questions), The Wrong Door (what-if questions), Cold Fries (this-or-that questions). Decks can be played one at a time or mixed together.
- The Spicy deck is for adults only (18+) and has three levels: Mild, Spicy and No mercy.
- Six languages: English, Lithuanian, German, Spanish, Italian and Polish.
- Favourite questions can be starred and saved on the device, and any card can be shared as an image or a link.
- Works on any phone browser and can be added to the home screen like an app.
- Free to play. Only anonymous usage data is collected; there are no accounts and no personal data.

## Who it is for

Friends, couples and date nights, families, parties, road trips, and work teams looking for icebreakers.
